title: Emily's Life
tagline: A crown princess. A bumbling superhero. One very secret antique store.
logline: A CBS–BBC co-produced live-action/animated superhero fantasy sitcom that aired for five seasons and one hundred and twenty-nine episodes.
paragraphs: The series follows Princess Emily, a pure-hearted and precocious ten-year-old with striking white hair, who belongs to the House of Emberlight, the ruling royal family of the magical kingdom of Corbonia.
Living with her younger twin siblings — the bookish Prince Francis and the adorable but mischievous Princess Georgia — she is first-in-line to the Royal Throne as the crown princess.
As she prepares for her future role as monarch, her parents, King Howard and Queen Carola, decide to send their eldest daughter to Los Angeles, California to experience life outside the royal bubble.
To her surprise, she discovers that the city is no stranger to dangerous supervillain activity, which is thankfully always stopped by the heroic yet bumbling Captain Man.

One day, Emily lands an after-school job at a quaint antique shop, the Bonbon Antique Store, only to discover that it serves as the secret hideout for Captain Man — the Man Cave — with her boss, Jim Morton, being the superhero himself.
Sworn to secrecy about this revelation, even from her royal family, Emily gains her own superpowers and takes on the role of Captain Man's sidekick, Super Ruby.
Their vibrant escapades turn Emily's once-ordinary life upside down — especially as Captain Man hints that he will soon need someone to step into his shoes.
